title: A Tennessee man left a late-1700s house and about $500,000 to local government for a park
summary_full: A historic home in Tennessee, along with $500,000, has been returned to its rightful family after local officials failed to fulfill the promise of establishing a public park as per the will. After a decade of inactivity, the descendant will take charge of crucial repairs and preservation efforts for the old house, shedding light on the complexities of municipal management involving donated heritage properties.
